source:
@@U02199@@
浮士德, bedded on a flowery meadow, exhausted, restless, trying to sleep. Graceful little SPIRITS hover over him in a circle. 阿里埃尔 sings accompanied by Aeolian harps.

@@U02201@@
When the rain of new spring blossoms Blesses every hill and glen, When green meadows, bright with showers, Gladden all the sons of men, Elvin creatures, great in power, Run to help where help they can, Whether he be good or evil, They sorrow for the luckless man. You spirits, elves, who hover in broad circles above his head, show him now the noble nature of elves. Ease his heart, root out the fierce strife that tears him, withdraw the bitter, burning arrows of self reproach and purge his soul of the horror he has known. Four are the watches of the night: fill them now with gentle kindness and no delay. Lower his head first on a cool pillow and bathe him in the dew of 勒忒河’s waters. His body, now cramped and rigid, will gather strength as he relaxes and rests to meet the new day. Perform your fairest task as elves, restore him to the sacred light.
translation:
@@U02199@@
浮士德躺在鲜花盛开的草地上，疲惫不堪，焦躁不安，想睡觉。优雅的小精灵在他上方盘旋一圈。 阿里埃尔在风琴的伴奏下歌唱。

@@U02201@@
当新春的雨花绽放，祝福每一个山丘和峡谷，当绿色的草地，因阵雨而明亮，让所有的人类之子欢欣鼓舞，埃尔文生物，力量强大，跑去帮助他们能帮助的地方，无论他是善还是恶，他们为这个不幸的人悲伤。你们这些精灵，精灵们，在他头顶上空盘旋，向他展示精灵的高贵本性。让他的心放松下来，根除撕扯他的激烈冲突，收回自责的痛苦燃烧的箭，清除他的灵魂中他所知道的恐怖。四是夜更：现在就用温柔的仁慈充满它们，不要拖延。首先将他的头放在凉爽的枕头上，然后用勒忒河的露水给他洗澡。他的身体现在已经局促僵硬，但在放松和休息的过程中，他会积聚力量，迎接新的一天。执行你作为精灵最公平的任务，让他恢复神圣之光。
